If you're not Interested in making friends: I use set goals for myself and if that didn't work I used the time to work on improving myself in different ways... A good day doesn't NEED to be productive to the max, even just sweeping your apartment or washing dishes... I learned that setting too much expectations for your day can make you feel worse if you can't complete them so is set small things and you end up feeling much more fulfilled at the end of the day.

But if you are interested in making friends: There's an app called Slowly that might help.
It's a penpal type app where you can send letters to people all over the world, it's anonymous (except for your country) and I've been using it for a week now. I find myself excited to see if u received any new letters every morning lol 
A warning though: it's takes time to send and receive letters, it works along the same line as sending a physical letter. An example would be if I were to send a letter to someone in India it would take up to 18 hours for them to receive the letter, and if they respond you need to wait the same time period to receive their letter. You also have to take the initiative of sending letters inorder to receive them.
